verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies bulk capability. Agents can query and manage the database through the official MCP server and agent skills (supabase-docs-1, supabase-docs-2), and set-based SQL lets one query act on many rows. Projects can also be managed programmatically through the Management API, and Cron and Queues support recurring or batched jobs. However, no evidence explicitly documents bulk or batch operations (multi-row upserts, batch endpoints, bulk file operations) as an agent-facing feature. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on bulk or batch operations across items, documented batch API endpoints, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven bulk edits.
